task: Perform the same Context, Location, Signal, bias, candidate setup, counter-evidence, and OBSERVE/WAIT assessment as A1. In addition, identify the nearest plausible structural target only when it is supported by the supplied past bars, cite the supporting structure, explain whether the context leaves room to that structure, and state what evidence would invalidate the thesis.
constraints: Use only the supplied market_input and its evidence_refs; cite only those exact references.
Treat decision_time as the strict information cutoff. Ignore later data and do not infer future outcomes.
The input contains reconstructed Binance UM OHLCV, not Gate quotes, account state, fees, news, or execution rules.
Do not invent news, unavailable evidence, executable prices, account facts, position sizes, leverage, risk approval, or net reward/risk.
Do not stretch a target to justify a directional view. Return UNKNOWN or NONE when no supporting structure is present.
Use UNKNOWN when evidence is insufficient. Preserve the strongest counter-evidence.
Allowed action values are OBSERVE and WAIT only. This is a market opinion, never an order or trading instruction.
